args.final_thought: [{"step":1,"file":"description.txt","function":"<global>","line":1,"var":"vulnerability description","code":"A harmless out-of-bounds read occurs during UCS table building.","note":"The reported issue is an out-of-bounds read in the UCS table-building path, so the trace follows attacker-controlled compressed input into the table construction code."},{"step":2,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/zlib/inflate.c","function":"inflate","line":1023,"var":"state->lens","code":"ret = inflate_table(LENS, state->lens, state->nlen, &(state->next), &(bits), state->work);","note":"Parsed dynamic Huffman code lengths from the compressed stream are handed to inflate_table() to build the literal/length decode table."},{"step":3,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/zlib/inftrees.c","function":"inflate_table","line":92,"var":"count[lens[sym]]","code":"for (sym = 0; sym < codes; sym++) count[lens[sym]]++;","note":"The function assumes lens[] entries are valid bit lengths and uses them as indices while counting code lengths, making malformed input directly influence table-building state."},{"step":4,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/zlib/inftrees.c","function":"inflate_table","line":188,"var":"work[sym]","code":"if (work[sym] + 1U < match) { ... } else if (work[sym] >= match) { ... }","note":"The sorted symbol list drives decode-entry generation; attacker-influenced lengths determine which symbols are emitted into the table."},{"step":5,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/zlib/inftrees.c","function":"inflate_table","line":236,"var":"next[huff]","code":"next[huff] = here;","note":"The table builder writes decode entries and invalid markers into the output table; the vulnerability hypothesis is that malformed UCS/table-building input can cause an out-of-bounds read during this construction path."}]
